title: Full DNS System — one profile, every device

intro.en: Pick a protection profile, pick your device, and copy the exact hostname, DoH URL or ready-to-run config. The same profile works on Android, iPhone, Windows, macOS, Linux, a whole-home router and a browser — so every device in the house gets the same filtering.
intro.bn: একটি প্রোফাইল বেছে নিন, আপনার ডিভাইস বেছে নিন — তারপর হুবহু hostname, DoH URL বা রেডি config কপি করুন। একই প্রোফাইল Android, iPhone, Windows, macOS, Linux, রাউটার ও ব্রাউজারে কাজ করে — ফলে বাড়ির সব ডিভাইসে একই ফিল্টারিং চালু থাকে।

profiles.name: Kids Guard
profiles.summary: Ads, trackers, malware and adult content blocked for every app, SafeSearch where supported, and Reels/Shorts hidden in the browser.
profiles.summary_bn: সব অ্যাপে অ্যাড, ট্র্যাকার, ম্যালওয়্যার ও অ্যাডাল্ট কনটেন্ট ব্লক; SafeSearch চালু; ব্রাউজারে Reels/Shorts লুকানো।
notes: AdGuard Family blocks ads, trackers and adult content, and enforces SafeSearch.
Cloudflare Family (family.cloudflare-dns.com) is the malware + adult alternative; it does not block ads.

Kids Guard uses AdGuard Family because it is no-log. Kahf Guard (medium.kahfguard.com) also blocks malware and gambling but keeps 48-hour logs — pick it from the profile list if you prefer that trade-off.
For a strict allow-list, use NextDNS with a child profile — it is free up to 300k queries/month.

profiles.name: Kahf Guard
profiles.summary: KahfDNS blocks ads, trackers, malware, adult content and gambling, enforces SafeSearch, and keeps social apps working. Logs auto-delete within 48 hours.
profiles.summary_bn: KahfDNS অ্যাড, ট্র্যাকার, ম্যালওয়্যার, অ্যাডাল্ট কনটেন্ট ও জুয়া ব্লক করে, SafeSearch চালু রাখে; সোশ্যাল অ্যাপ চলবে। লগ ৪৮ ঘণ্টায় মুছে যায়।
notes: KahfDNS is the family/halal filter from Kahf Guard: 1.6M+ harmful sites, ads, adult content and gambling are blocked.
SafeSearch is enforced (www.google.com resolves to forcesafesearch.google.com). The provider also advertises YouTube Restricted Mode.
Facebook, Messenger, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp keep working — only harmful domains are blocked.
Query logs are deleted within 48 hours (minimal-log). AdGuard Family is the no-log alternative.
DoH is HTTP/2-only; Windows 11 and all modern browsers support it. DoQ and DoH3 are also offered.

profiles.name: Ad Block
profiles.summary: Ads and trackers blocked device-wide. Everything else — social apps, video, chat — keeps working.
profiles.summary_bn: পুরো ডিভাইসে অ্যাড ও ট্র্যাকার ব্লক; বাকি সব — সোশ্যাল অ্যাপ, ভিডিও, চ্যাট — আগের মতোই চলবে।
notes: dns.adguard-dns.com is the most popular free ad-blocking resolver.
If an app misbehaves, switch that device to dns-unfiltered.adguard.com temporarily.
dnsforge.de (ads + malware, no-log, Germany) is a good alternative.

profiles.name: Family Safe
profiles.summary: Adult content and malware blocked with SafeSearch, without ad filtering. Normal apps and videos keep working.
profiles.summary_bn: অ্যাড ফিল্টার ছাড়াই অ্যাডাল্ট কনটেন্ট ও ম্যালওয়্যার ব্লক, সঙ্গে SafeSearch; সাধারণ অ্যাপ ও ভিডিও চলবে।
notes: family.cloudflare-dns.com blocks malware and adult content and enforces SafeSearch.
It does not block ads — pair it with ShortsGuard/uBlock if you also want an ad-free web.
CleanBrowsing Family Filter (family-filter-dns.cleanbrowsing.org) is a stricter alternative.

profiles.name: Privacy (no-log)
profiles.summary: Encrypted, no-log, no filtering. The cleanest resolver when you do not want any blocking.
profiles.summary_bn: এনক্রিপ্টেড, no-log, কোনো ফিল্টার নেই। ব্লকিং না চাইলে সবচেয়ে পরিষ্কার রিজলভার।
notes: Quad9 blocks known-malicious domains by default; dns10.quad9.net is the unfiltered variant.
Mullvad (doh.mullvad.net) and Wikimedia DNS (wikimedia-dns.org) are also no-log.
No filtering means ads, trackers and adult sites are not blocked — use another profile if you need that.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.summary: Private DNS (DoT) — built in, no app, no root.
steps: Open Settings → Network & internet → Private DNS.
Choose “Private DNS provider hostname”.
Paste {{ANDROID_HOST}} and tap Save.
Verify at 1.1.1.1/help — it should say “Using DNS over TLS (DoT)”.

platforms.name: iPhone / iPad
platforms.summary: DoH profile through a free app or a .mobileconfig.
steps: Install DNSecure (free) from the App Store, or use an existing .mobileconfig profile.
Add a custom DoH server: {{DOH_URL}}
Enable the profile and turn on “Encrypted DNS”.
For Kids Guard, also set Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions → Allowed Apps / Web Content.

platforms.name: Windows 10/11
platforms.summary: Built-in DoH with a one-file PowerShell script.
steps: Open PowerShell as Administrator.
Run the generated script (copy it or download windows-dns.ps1).
Settings → Network & internet → your adapter → DNS shows the new servers.
Verify with: Resolve-DnsName example.com

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.summary: System DNS with a small shell script; DoH through a profile.
steps: Run the generated script in Terminal (it asks for sudo).
Or use System Settings → Network → Details… → DNS.
For encrypted DNS, install a DoH profile with {{DOH_URL}}.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.summary: systemd-resolved with DNS-over-TLS for the whole machine.
steps: Copy the generated file to /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/dns.conf.
Run: sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved
Check: resolvectl status — look for “+DNSOverTLS”.

platforms.name: Router / whole home
platforms.summary: AdGuard Home, Pi-hole, dnsmasq or OpenWrt — one setting for every device.
steps: Pick the stack you already run (AdGuard Home, Pi-hole, dnsmasq or stubby).
Paste the generated upstream list into that stack.
Point your DHCP DNS at the router and reconnect the devices.
Test from a phone on Wi-Fi — every device now uses the profile.

platforms.name: Browser only
platforms.summary: Chrome / Edge / Firefox secure DNS — no OS change.
steps: Chrome / Edge / Brave: Settings → Privacy and security → Security → Use secure DNS → Custom.
Paste {{DOH_URL}}.
Firefox: Privacy & Security → DNS over HTTPS → Increased Protection → Custom.

windows-dns.ps1: # DoH templates require Windows 11 22H2+ / Windows Server 2022.
Write-Host 'This Windows build has no DoH cmdlet; DNS is set but not encrypted.'
Write-Host 'Use Windows 11 22H2+ or set DoH in the browser.'
macos-dns.sh: echo 'macOS has no native DoH. Install a DoH profile with: {{DOH_URL}}'
dnsmasq.conf: # dnsmasq cannot speak DoT. Forward to stubby on 127.0.0.1:5053:
# Plain-DNS fallback (no encryption) if stubby is not available:
adguardhome-upstreams.txt: # {{PROFILE_NAME}} — AdGuard Home → Settings → DNS settings → Upstream DNS servers
# Bootstrap DNS for the DoT/DoH hostname:
pihole-upstreams.txt: # {{PROFILE_NAME}} — Pi-hole → Settings → DNS → Upstream DNS servers (custom)
# Pi-hole speaks plain DNS. Put stubby (127.0.0.1:5053) or cloudflared in front for encryption.
safesearch.conf: # SafeSearch enforcement — Kids Guard / Kahf Guard / Family Safe
# AdGuard Home: Filters → DNS rewrites → add these CNAME records:
# dnsmasq 2.86+: add these lines to dnsmasq.conf
# Pi-hole: Local DNS → CNAME Records (same mapping)
